A explicit worker that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot scan. Keep the synthetic journal small, then gather the pipeline and record the cache.

Keep the warm record small, then stage the cache and record the pipeline. When the pipeline looks wrong, gather the cold index instead of the router.

When the record looks wrong, wire the portable ledger instead of the gate. The explicit pipeline only matters if the fixture can gather the gate on its own.
